purpose: Candidate discovery index; not a completed semantic inventory or compliance claim

method.universe: git ls-files, tracked source suffixes within declared roots
method.excluded: dependencies, build/generated directories, .d.ts; vendor checked separately for parity
limitations: Regex candidates can include comments, handled exceptions and harmless cancellation.
Dynamic dispatch/imported wrappers and error returns without matched names need source review.
Test file presence is not passing test evidence.
A zero lexical candidate count does not establish absence of error ownership; every source file remains in the review backlog.

vendor_parity.comparison: All 24 emitted JS/declaration files byte-identical; generated/vendor runtime file sets equal. Packaging metadata outside comparison.

verified_findings.observation: Recipient business checks throw raw Nest 4xx exceptions before sender approval, pending-log creation and provider invocation. No generic status-to-outcome inference is authorized.
verified_findings.outcome_evidence: sendSms awaits resolveSmsRecipients before ensureApproved, createPendingSmsLog and aligoService.sendSms.

verified_findings.observation: Rejected requests and malformed successes are grouped as failed recipients and the UI invites retry without establishing NOT_APPLIED. handleSubmit also lacks a synchronous in-flight guard across duplicate-history lookup.
verified_findings.outcome_evidence: Promise.allSettled rejection does not establish provider nonacceptance. Current feedback treats it as failure and retains retryable recipients.
verified_findings.api_boundary_gap: sendSms currently replaces Axios errors with plain Error and loses Problem Details. Preserve original error in this method and verify the actual boundary.
verified_findings.dispatch_gate: pending amended independent PLAN review and exact SHA binding
